title: Isomorphism factorizations of the complete graph into Cayley graphs on CI-groups
summary: Isomorphic factorizations of complete graphs originate from the seminal work of Frank Harary and collaborators, who initiated the systematic study of decompositions of complete graphs into pairwise isomorphic spanning subgraphs. In this paper, we investigate isomorphic factorizations of complete graphs into Cayley graphs on CI-groups. Let $Γ=Cay(G,S)$ denote the Cayley graph of finite group $G$. We obtain a necessary and sufficient condition on CI-group $G$ so that the complete graph on $|G|$ vertices can be edge-partitioned into $k$-copies of Cayley graph of the same CI-group $G$ each…
